plugins.name: janus
plugins.description: Two-faced by design: one gate looking forward at the plan, one looking back at the proof. Architect/builder/reviewer/verifier agents, services in tmux, a ledger only the verifier can close, proof-of-done, auto-handoff. Runs alone; gates arrive as terminal prompts.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: The cockpit: every tmux window as a live terminal in the browser, gates and questions as cards, proof gallery, fleet across projects. Install beside janus.
